After years of taking Kratom I built up quite a tolerance.
After years of taking Kratom I built up quite a tolerance.
The dosage of 50 g Kratom in the following experience is not recommended for new/ intermediate users.
I was not on any other medications or drugs at the time I decided to try this mixture of adderall and Kratom. I was in my room by myself and decided I wanted to chase a high that was similar to that of a Percocet and cocaine speedball. To my surprise, it was very, very close.
I started by taking 50 g in capsules, a large dose for me, to pursue the euphoric/sedative effect of the substance. I waited an hour for the capsules to dissolve and the effects to kick in. (Quick note: if
I could handle the terrible taste of drinking Kratom mixed in water, the effects take place almost instantly. I just prefer the capsules because I dont mind waiting) I then sniffed a moderate dose of 30 mg adderall.
Because the Kratom has already kicked in at this point and crushing/snorting adderall makes it take effect almost immediately, the speedball high onset was instantaneous.
I have to tell you, this speedball of Kratom and adderall was just as good, if not better,
than a cocaine and Percocet speedball. There was the energy, the euphoria, the confidence, the numbness to anxiety and the increased social abilities. It felt like the coke/perc speedball at a fraction of the price and without the dangerous side effects.
At this point in my life I wasnt in the best spirits, however, the effects made me genuinely happy. There was no heart racing, no drowsiness and the effects lasted much longer. It was 100% a party drug feeling. The tenseness in my body was gone and I felt on top of the world both mentally and physically.
